provider_terminal.final_payload_summary: Completed one vessel with explicit termination and final assay; no batch was discarded. Used 0.040 mol reagent, 40 mL acetonitrile and 0.002 mol Catalyst A. Extended heating from a 350 K setpoint to 370 K as HPLC yield estimates rose from 0.101 to 0.524, then quenched. Distilled at 365 K/reflux 8, followed by 350 K/reflux 10, and collected the available fraction. Final assay: distillate purity 0.2442 (FAIL: target ≥0.80), recovery 0.9705 (PASS: target ≥0.10), yield 0.5253, conversion 0.5188 and solvent loss 0. Native leaderboard score: 0.429684. Thus, the overall quality goal was not met despite high recovery. Used 17/72 operations and five nonfinal measurements; reported physical cost totaled 2.2237 benchmark units, with peak risk 0.3412 below the 0.65 limit. Purity remained the principal limitation; this single adaptive trajectory does not establish causal effects or an optimal recipe.
